newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian Radenska to be listed on April 3.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian Radenska to be listed on April 3.

text.p: Slovenian health resort operator and mineral water producer Radenska will be listed on the main market of the Ljubljana bourse on April 3, the bourse said on Friday.
The company will list 4.1 million shares that represent 81.2 percent of the firm's equity and have a nominal value of 1,000 tolars each.
Radenska stock currently trades at around 1,500 tolars ($9.8) on the grey market.
Thirty-two newly privatised companies that have been listed on the Ljubljana bourse since January last year.
At the moment there are 26 shares traded on the main market and 35 on the OTC market of the Ljubljana bourse.
